## Verification

- `node --test dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js dist/__tests__/rubrics.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #410

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #412 closes #410 by trying to avoid wasteful rubrics-review model runs when there is nothing to score.
- The intended behavior is to preflight rubric read policy, rubric branch availability, and selected active rubric count before provider/model work.
- The PR updates the rubrics-review workflow, adds workflow-regression assertions, and updates docs describing the skip behavior.
- The implementation matches the requested shape conceptually, but the current workflow ordering breaks clean-checkout execution.

## Review
The synthesis finds one blocking implementation regression. Claude and the rubrics lane judged the PR shippable, while Codex flagged a clean-checkout failure; current PR evidence supports Codex’s blocker.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Preflight runs compiled CLIs before runtime setup | BLOCKING | [`agent-rubrics-review.yml#L89`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/b59fe4dc2aa4418f2b0acce9299bc5c04387e631/.github/workflows/agent-rubrics-review.yml#L89) calls `.agent/dist` before `setup-agent-runtime`, but `.agent/dist/` is ignored and absent from the PR tree. A clean Actions checkout will fail before the intended skip logic can run; the later `select.js` preflight has the same dependency class. |
| Selection parity is implicit | WARNING | The preflight selector flags currently match the real rubrics-review selector in `run-agent-task`, but that parity is not enforced. Future drift could silently skip a rubrics-review lane that would otherwise select active rubrics. |

## Progress
- #410’s requested behavior is acknowledged and the PR updates docs plus workflow tests for the intended skip path.
- Existing top-level PR discussion includes a passing rubrics review and implementation summary.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were re-fetched before mutation; none existed.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.github/workflows/agent-rubrics-review.yml` line 89 for the blocking runtime-order issue.
- No inline replies, thread resolutions, or comment minimizations were performed.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Preflight runs compiled CLIs before runtime setup</summary>

**Cause:** The new preflight is inserted before `Resolve rubrics review provider` and `Setup agent runtime`, but it invokes `node .agent/dist/cli/rubrics/resolve-policy.js`. The setup action is what runs `npm ci` and `npm run build`, and the PR tree has no tracked `.agent/dist/` files.

**Candidate solutions:** Move the preflight after a deterministic Node dependency/build setup, split the runtime setup so build-only work can happen before provider/model CLI setup, or replace this preflight with a checked-in helper that does not depend on `.agent/dist` or `.agent/node_modules`. Update the workflow test so it catches the chosen ordering invariant.

**Comments:** The existing regression test asserts workflow text and skip strings, but it does not catch this clean-checkout failure mode.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Selection parity is implicit</summary>

**Cause:** The preflight uses `--best-effort --all-routes --limit all`, which currently matches the rubrics-review path in [`run-agent-task`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/b59fe4dc2aa4418f2b0acce9299bc5c04387e631/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L309-L335). Nothing ties those call sites together.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a small comment at both call sites, or add a workflow test that asserts the preflight and real rubrics-review selector stay aligned.

**Comments:** This is not the current blocker because the flags match today; it is a maintenance risk noted by one reviewer.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the blocking workflow-ordering issue requires a concrete branch change and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Fix the rubrics-review preflight so it does not invoke `.agent/dist` or dependency-backed CLIs before runtime dependencies/build output exist.
- [ ] Add or update regression coverage to catch the preflight/runtime setup ordering invariant.

        if: ${{ steps.rubrics_mode.outputs.read_enabled == 'true' }}

@sepo-agent /answer why did you add all these here?

That block was added to make `agent-rubrics-review.yml` decide **before the model/provider path** whether a rubrics review is worth running.

The reason is issue #410: when `agent/rubrics` is missing, or when there are zero active rubrics, Sepo was still doing the expensive path: resolve provider, set up runtime/provider tools, run the rubrics-review agent, then post an `N/A / 0 rubrics` style comment. That was noisy and wasted a model run.

So this block does three preflight checks:

- `Download rubrics for review preflight`: checks whether the rubrics branch exists, without bootstrapping it.
- `Count active rubrics for review`: uses the existing rubric selector to see whether anything would actually be scored.
- `Resolve rubrics review preflight`: turns that into `should_run=true/false` plus a human-readable skip reason.

If `should_run=false`, the workflow only writes an Actions notice/summary and skips provider setup, model execution, artifacts, and PR comments.

The reason it is in this workflow instead of only inside `run-agent-task` is timing: `run-agent-task` happens after provider/runtime setup, which is exactly the work this PR is trying to avoid when there are no rubrics to score.
